queries.bounds: First returned result sets; no pagination/date filter or exhaustive review claimed. Official primary URLs were then acquired independently with per-request UTC receipts.

dedup_interpretation: 10 corpus lines were frontier leads, not an existing maintained lindbergite owner or accepted Ferrier/Farkas mechanism. 37 prior raw lines included IMA identity and related moolooite synthetic context. Search includes hidden/ignored files, follows relevant symlinks, and explicitly limits unextracted binary content.

assessment.accepted_source: Ferrier et al. 2019 DOI 10.1111/1462-2920.14591; one study with solid and liquid COG_MN35 powder arms.
assessment.accepted_claim: Source-assigned lindbergite formation in A. niger ATCC 1015 cultures on mixed natural manganese nodule powder; not pure feed, quantified mineral yield or industrial recovery.
assessment.identity: IMA 2003-029, September 2026 row PDF p126; handbook monoclinic C2/c MnC2O4.2H2O. Distinct from orthorhombic Mn oxalate dihydrate and falottaite trihydrate.
assessment.not_accepted_as_replication: Farkas et al. 2020 DOI 10.3390/jof6040270 uses CBS 140837 and synthetic hausmannite. Table 2 calls an orthorhombic cell lindbergite; identity conflict prevents accepting that exact mineral formation as independent lindbergite replication.
assessment.shared_study: The parent is independently curating falottaite from Farkas 2020. Shared study references across distinct phases do not add experimental replication.
assessment.criticality: No criticality designation asserted or inherited.
assessment.quantitation: No schema quantitative observation added: percent pulp loading and unquantified phase assignments are not source concentration cells in mg/kg.
assessment.controls: Solid matched uninoculated pattern displayed; liquid uninoculated flask and no-mineral fungal pellets displayed. No killed-cell, cell-free or acid-matched formation series. No direct oxalate assay, phase mass fraction or Mn mass balance.
primary_limits: Liquid inoculum methods final 10^4 spores/mL versus Figure 6 10^6 spores/mL.
Solid recovery methods state 125 rpm despite plate protocol; preserve ambiguity.
Approximately 70 C extraction/washing and week-long drying precede solid XRPD; live hydration unmeasured.
Figure 8 names calcium oxalate monohydrate while corresponding results name dihydrate.
ICDD-based phase assignment lacks specimen-specific cell refinement or water-content assay.
AP1 contains Ca and trace Mn, with no provenance tracer.
At least three determinations does not specify biological versus analytical replication.
farkas_context_limits: Table 2 orthorhombic versus authoritative monoclinic lindbergite identity.
Section 3.5 says falottaite identified day 20; Discussion first detected after day 15 and misreferences Figure 5a.
Figure 6 has an additional unlabelled lower curve; do not assign its time.
Methods scan 20-80 degrees but displayed Figure 6 starts at 10 degrees.
No uninoculated or pH-matched formation control series.
Mn/As partitions include mineral associated with biomass; not phase-specific yield or intracellular uptake.
Section 2.4 analytical-method ordering differs from explicit Section 2.5 assignments.
future_work: Resolve experimental Mn oxalate polymorph by accessible raw diffraction/refinement and hydration evidence; no contact attempted.
Consider cited Wei 2012 birnessite transformation as a separately acquired primary, not as evidence already inspected.
Do not promote 2022 synthetic polymorph context into a microbial mechanism.

inspection.ferrier2019: All 13 PDF pages including repository cover, 12 article pages, Figures 1-8 and Table 1 visually inspected; full JATS and methods read.
inspection.farkas2020: All 12 main PDF pages, Figures 1-8 and Tables 1-2 visually inspected; full JATS and methods read.
inspection.ima2026: Original pages 1,2,67,126 visually inspected (definitions, licence, falottaite and lindbergite).
inspection.handbook: Entire original one-page mineral entry visually inspected.
inspection.synthesis2022: PMC9738142 full JATS acquired, identity/polymorph passages read; NOT all figures or SI assessed, context only.
inspection.supplements: Both complete JATS files contain zero supplementary-material nodes; media archives each contain eight main JPG figures plus eight GIF thumbnails. No separate SI identified in these artifacts/full PDFs/bounded search; no global absence assertion.
inspection.taxonomy: NCBI API current species 5061 and official ATCC 1015 page independently read; strain identity not inferred from species TaxID.

access_and_rights.ferrier: Dundee cover labels publisher version, CC BY; actual embedded article carries early pagination 1-12, while Crossref/JATS final journal citation is 21(5):1821-1832. Online-date differences are not resolved; no exact online day asserted.
access_and_rights.farkas: Original MDPI PDF and Europe PMC full JATS, CC BY 4.0.
access_and_rights.ima: Official September 2026 list; page2 CC BY-SA 3.0.
access_and_rights.handbook: MSA mineral authority entry; not redistributing original PDF in Git.
access_and_rights.failed_routes: Initial sandbox DNS failures retained in acquisition-1; subsequent permitted source acquisitions succeeded. RRUFF original Atencio 2004 PDF route failed with connection refused; original mineral-description paper not claimed read.
access_and_rights.policy: Raw full text, figure images and bulk authority PDF remain outside Git. The maintained dossier contains original assessment and artifact provenance.
